text: Its not around anymore. Im saying it did work. Its not in git history either so you wont find it but yeah. also, i would suggest you get a host based system in there since we will 100% have to go that route anyways
resolution: Built the host-based aim system the user asked for (we will need it game-wide anyway). New host binding __game_camera_ray (framework/v8_bindings_game_camera.zig) backed by camera.zig activeCameraRay(), which returns the ACTIVE camera's resolved optical axis (pos -> normalized target-pos) from the controller's smoothed current Solved — the crosshair truth only the host has. Exposed as GAME_NATIVE_CAMERA.activeRay() in nativeCamera.ts. combat-arena's player fire now casts that exact ray (fixes diagonal bullets), falling back to GAME_CAMERA.orientation when the binding is absent so it works before the rebuild. Also: NPCs render as hitboxes (head fix), crosshair centered, crash-proof onFrame. zig ast-check clean on both Zig files; esbuild bundle clean. NEEDS A ZIG REBUILD for the host ray path (JS changes hot-reload now).
